## 5-Night Vegetarian Dinner Plan for 2

Context note: Costs are estimated from typical U.S. budget-grocery pricing and use your listed pantry staples to keep the total under target.

Option 1: Black Bean Fajita Bowls | Roasted peppers/onions, black beans, rice, yogurt-lime drizzle | **~28 g protein/serving**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

- Estimated cost: **$8 total** / **$4 per serving**
- Main ingredients: 2 bell peppers, 1 onion, 2 cans black beans, 1 cup Greek yogurt, lime, rice, spices
- Brief steps:
  - Slice peppers and onion; toss with oil, cumin, paprika, salt, pepper; roast at 425°F for about 20 minutes.
  - Warm black beans on the stovetop with garlic, cumin, and a splash of soy sauce.
  - Blend or stir Greek yogurt with lime juice, salt, and a little garlic.
  - Serve over cooked rice.
- Leftover use:
  - Extra fajita veg can go into Day 5 quesadillas or a lunch rice bowl.
  - Any extra yogurt-lime sauce works as a dip for roasted vegetables.

Option 2: Red Lentil Coconut Curry with Spinach | Fast one-pot curry over rice | **~26 g protein/serving**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

- Estimated cost: **$7 total** / **$3.50 per serving**
- Main ingredients: red lentils, 1 can light coconut milk, 1 onion, spinach, diced tomatoes, rice, garlic, cumin, paprika
- Brief steps:
  - Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
  - Add 1 cup red lentils, 1 can diced tomatoes, 1 can coconut milk, 1 to 1½ cups water, cumin, paprika, salt, pepper.
  - Simmer 15–18 minutes until creamy.
  - Stir in spinach for 2 minutes and serve over rice.
- Leftover use:
  - Make extra curry and use it as a thick soup or lunch with toast.
  - Leftover curry also works inside a baked potato.

Option 3: Tofu Broccoli Stir-Fry with Edamame | High-protein soy-ginger style bowl | **~31 g protein/serving**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

- Estimated cost: **$10 total** / **$5 per serving**
- Main ingredients: 2 blocks extra-firm tofu, 1 head broccoli, 1 bag frozen shelled edamame, soy sauce, rice, garlic
- Brief steps:
  - Press and cube tofu; sear in a hot skillet with oil until golden.
  - Steam or microwave edamame; chop broccoli and stir-fry until crisp-tender.
  - Add garlic, soy sauce, a little water, pepper, and oregano or cumin if desired.
  - Toss together and serve over rice.
- Leftover use:
  - Extra tofu/veg can become fried rice for lunch.
  - Blend leftover edamame with yogurt, garlic, and lemon/lime for a quick spread or dip.

Option 4: White Bean Pasta e Spinaci | The one pasta night with white beans, spinach, and Parmesan | **~28 g protein/serving**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

- Estimated cost: **$9 total** / **$4.50 per serving**
- Main ingredients: 8 oz whole-wheat pasta, 2 cans cannellini beans, spinach, 1 lemon, Parmesan, garlic, oregano
- Brief steps:
  - Boil pasta.
  - In a skillet, sauté garlic in olive oil; add drained beans, oregano, black pepper, and a splash of pasta water.
  - Stir in spinach to wilt, then toss with pasta, lemon zest/juice, and Parmesan.
  - Mash some of the beans for a creamier texture.
- Leftover use:
  - Leftover pasta can be reheated with a splash of water for lunch.
  - Extra Parmesan and spinach can top Day 5 quesadillas or bowls.

Option 5: Black Bean & Spinach Quesadillas with Corn-Tomato Salsa | Fast baked or skillet quesadillas | **~27 g protein/serving**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

- Estimated cost: **$9 total** / **$4.50 per serving**
- Main ingredients: flour tortillas, 2 cans black beans, shredded cheddar or Mexican blend, spinach, frozen corn, tomatoes, Greek yogurt
- Brief steps:
  - Mash black beans with garlic, cumin, paprika, and a little soy sauce or salt.
  - Fill tortillas with beans, cheese, and spinach; cook in skillet or bake until crisp.
  - Mix chopped tomatoes, thawed corn, lime, salt, and pepper for salsa.
  - Serve with Greek yogurt.
- Leftover use:
  - Use leftover fajita vegetables from Day 1 inside the quesadillas.
  - Extra salsa can top rice bowls or the lentil curry the next day.

## Consolidated Grocery List Under Budget

This list covers all 5 dinners for 2 adults and leaves room under your **$75** cap for price variation.

### Produce
- 3 bell peppers
- 3 yellow onions
- 2 limes
- 1 lemon
- 2 medium tomatoes
- 2 heads broccoli
- 2 bags or clamshells spinach

### Refrigerated
- 2 blocks extra-firm tofu
- 1 large tub plain Greek yogurt
- 1 bag shredded cheddar or Mexican blend cheese
- 1 wedge/container Parmesan

### Canned / Jarred / Frozen
- 4 cans black beans
- 2 cans cannellini beans
- 1 can diced tomatoes
- 1 can light coconut milk
- 1 bag frozen shelled edamame
- 1 bag frozen corn

### Grains / Bread
- 1 box whole-wheat pasta
- 1 pack flour tortillas

### Estimated shopping cost by category
- Produce: **~$16**
- Refrigerated: **~$19**
- Canned/frozen: **~$16**
- Grains/tortillas: **~$6**
- Buffer for regional price differences: **~$18**
- Estimated max total: **~$57–$61**

## Leftover Strategy Across the 5 Days

- Cook a **big pot of rice on Day 1** and reuse for Days 2 and 3.
- Roast **extra peppers/onions on Day 1** and fold them into Day 5 quesadillas.
- Make **double yogurt-lime sauce** once and use it with bowls, quesadillas, or as a veggie dip.
- Cook **extra lentil curry on Day 2** for one easy lunch.
- Save **extra stir-fry tofu and broccoli on Day 3** for fried rice or wraps.
- Use leftover **spinach, cheese, and beans** flexibly in pasta, quesadillas, or quick lunch bowls.

## Quick Prep Flow for Easier Weeknights

- Before Day 1:
  - Press tofu and store it ready to cook.
  - Wash spinach and broccoli.
  - Mix a small jar of fajita seasoning: cumin, paprika, oregano, salt, pepper.
- Midweek:
  - Pre-chop onions and peppers for 2 dinners at once.
  - Portion cooked rice into containers for faster reheating.
